name: YouTube TV Enhancer
description: Auto-enables theater mode, hides sidebar/comments/header for a clean TV viewing experience

params.css: #masthead-container, #masthead, ytd-masthead { display: none !important; } #secondary, #related, #comments, #meta, ytd-comments, #below { display: none !important; } #primary { max-width: 100% !important; } #player-theater-container, #full-bleed-container { max-height: 100vh !important; } #page-manager { margin-top: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; } ytd-watch-flexy[theater] #player-theater-container { max-height: 100vh !important; min-height: 100vh !important; } #movie_player { max-height: 100vh !important; } .ytp-chrome-top { display: none !important; }

params.code: var btn = document.querySelector('.ytp-size-button, button[data-tooltip-target-id="ytp-size-button"]'); if (btn && !document.querySelector('ytd-watch-flexy[theater]')) btn.click(); return 'theater';
var ad = document.querySelector('.ytp-ad-skip-button, .ytp-ad-skip-button-modern, .ytp-skip-ad-button'); if (ad) ad.click(); return ad ? 'skipped' : 'no-ad';
